description: This Java interface, ScopedConfig, extends the Config interface from the Typesafe Config library and provides additional functionality for retrieving configuration values with validation, such as non-negative durations and positive integers, within a specific configuration scope in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ScopedConfig
classes.description: An interface extending Config that includes methods for retrieving configuration values with validation and tracking of the configuration path.

methods.name: getNonNegativeDurationOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a Duration from the config at a specified path, ensuring it is non-negative; throws DittoConfigError if the duration is negative.

methods.name: getPositiveIntOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves an integer from the config at a specified path, ensuring it is positive; throws DittoConfigError if the value is zero or negative.
